searchText: Hi guys, I am trying to understand rewards. I was convinced that block proposer receives also some reward for proposing the block, but when I went through Ben Edgington's eth2book.info (https://eth2book.info/bellatrix/part2/incentives/rewards/) it seems that block proposer only gets rewards from including attestations. Am I right? no you get rewards for attestations, but also if you're lucky enough to propose a block you get fees as reward ( not some set amount like with pow) Hmm but the equations on the link above prove that you can quite precisely determine the reward Or when you say "fees" are you referring to so called "tip" for transaction inclusion? I mean, a different question to ask is, why would we want to pay a block proposer for doing nothing useful (i.e. not including attestations, slashings, etc)? Most of the sources online are nonchalantly calling it "reward for proposing a block" or similar. Thus, I thought proposing also brings some reward by itself. I though it is just one of the rewards that also helps to keep nodes encouraged to validate and hopefully propose every now and then including attestations and sync committee signatures is a very reliable and predictable amount and it's in everyone's interest to include them, you can think of it as the "base reward" if you like while the network is in clear consensus you will have one well aggregated (95%+) attestation per subnet for you to include at each slot plus a little extra if you have space for them Thanks for response! Yes, I agree, but the point of my question was to check if there is any reward for just pure act of proposing a block (without including attestations) and it seems that there is actually not care to elaborate why one would chose not to include attestations (and still expect a reward in return)? purely hypothetical? this would be like a delivery service that gets paid per item, comes to your door but brings no items, wonders why it doesn't get paid 🤷‍♂️ I meant in addition to rewards received for including attestation, I thought that there might be also reward for act of proposing as well. Like sum_reward = reward_for_proposing + attestations_inclusion_reward current total rewards for just doing what the network expects of the proposer is quite reliably ~0.031ETH though, that's clearly enough of an incentive Hmm can you please point me how you reached (or from where) this number of 0.031 ETH? just take any validator that recently proposed, beaconchain explains the balance change if you hover the value: https://beaconcha.in/validator/452934 Ahhh you mean the consensus income :D? Yeah, that is probably just sum of attestation inclusion rewards "consensus income" is mainly rewards from making and including attestations Yep so you meant some sort of EL base reward? there is none, if i'm not mistaken EL does not create any more coins since the merge etherscan also shows this as plain zero Yes, I guess you can look at it like that. You are right, there are no more block rewards. If I am not mistaken now you can only get "tip"

excerpts.author: jovanka_
excerpts.content: Hi guys, I am trying to understand rewards. I was convinced that block proposer receives also some reward for proposing the block, but when I went through Ben Edgington's eth2book.info (https://eth2book.info/bellatrix/part2/incentives/rewards/) it seems that block proposer only gets rewards from including attestations. Am I right?

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content: no you get rewards for attestations, but also if you're lucky enough to propose a block you get fees as reward ( not some set amount like with pow)

excerpts.author: jovanka_
excerpts.content: Hmm but the equations on the link above prove that you can quite precisely determine the reward

excerpts.author: jovanka_
excerpts.content: Or when you say "fees" are you referring to so called "tip" for transaction inclusion?

excerpts.author: pietjepuk
excerpts.content: I mean, a different question to ask is, why would we want to pay a block proposer for doing nothing useful (i.e. not including attestations, slashings, etc)?

excerpts.author: jovanka_
excerpts.content: Most of the sources online are nonchalantly calling it "reward for proposing a block" or similar. Thus, I thought proposing also brings some reward by itself. I though it is just one of the rewards that also helps to keep nodes encouraged to validate and hopefully propose every now and then

excerpts.author: arnili
excerpts.content: including attestations and sync committee signatures is a very reliable and predictable amount and it's in everyone's interest to include them, you can think of it as the "base reward" if you like

excerpts.author: arnili
excerpts.content: while the network is in clear consensus you will have one well aggregated (95%+) attestation per subnet for you to include at each slot plus a little extra if you have space for them

excerpts.author: jovanka_
excerpts.content: Thanks for response! Yes, I agree, but the point of my question was to check if there is any reward for just pure act of proposing a block (without including attestations) and it seems that there is actually not

excerpts.author: arnili
excerpts.content: care to elaborate why one would chose not to include attestations (and still expect a reward in return)? purely hypothetical?

excerpts.author: arnili
excerpts.content: this would be like a delivery service that gets paid per item, comes to your door but brings no items, wonders why it doesn't get paid 🤷‍♂️

excerpts.author: jovanka_
excerpts.content: I meant in addition to rewards received for including attestation, I thought that there might be also reward for act of proposing as well. Like sum_reward = reward_for_proposing + attestations_inclusion_reward

excerpts.author: arnili
excerpts.content: current total rewards for just doing what the network expects of the proposer is quite reliably ~0.031ETH though, that's clearly enough of an incentive

excerpts.author: jovanka_
excerpts.content: Hmm can you please point me how you reached (or from where) this number of 0.031 ETH?

excerpts.author: arnili
excerpts.content: just take any validator that recently proposed, beaconchain explains the balance change if you hover the value: https://beaconcha.in/validator/452934

excerpts.author: jovanka_
excerpts.content: Ahhh you mean the consensus income :D?

excerpts.author: jovanka_
excerpts.content: Yeah, that is probably just sum of attestation inclusion rewards

excerpts.author: arnili
excerpts.content: "consensus income" is mainly rewards from making and including attestations

excerpts.author: jovanka_
excerpts.content: Yep

excerpts.author: arnili
excerpts.content: so you meant some sort of EL base reward? there is none, if i'm not mistaken EL does not create any more coins since the merge

excerpts.author: arnili
excerpts.content: etherscan also shows this as plain zero

excerpts.author: jovanka_
excerpts.content: Yes, I guess you can look at it like that. You are right, there are no more block rewards. If I am not mistaken now you can only get "tip"
